- A RUN THAT STOPS BEFORE THE PANEL STILL STORES ITS CALL COSTS (ASK 641; engine nodes Panel Tokens, Salvage Tokens, Salvage Write Tokens? and Salvage Write Tokens; Shared Library entry Panel Tokens): the collector is one text, the Shared Library entry `Panel Tokens` (function panelTokens). Panel Tokens and Salvage Tokens are stubs that rebuild that entry, check its length and return its result. Each stub's header names literally every node the collector reads, as the task runner requires, so a node that calls a model is added to the collector and to both headers in the same write. On the salvage path the order is Salvage Save -> Salvage Tokens -> Salvage Write Tokens? -> Salvage Write Tokens -> Save Incomplete to Drive. Salvage Write Tokens? is true unless Init Seats' regrade or dry is true; when it is false the write is passed over. Salvage Write Tokens posts to rpc/record_debate_row_tokens the run token of Failure Salvage, the list as p_calls, and the four token arguments as null, so call_costs and run_cost_usd are stored and the four token totals stay as they were. Salvage Tokens and Salvage Write Tokens continue on error, so the Drive save still runs. When Salvage Save fails there is no row and no cost is written. A run that reaches the panel is unchanged. No price, prompt or model setting is changed, and record_debate_row_tokens is unchanged. Not shown by a run. Mark for the first run that stops on the salvage path: its row holds call_costs with one entry per call made before the stop, and run_cost_usd is not NULL.
